description: Keeps the code on GitHub (without a token, through the while App) or GitLab: a push to the default branch deploys production, a pull or merge request opens a preview; unlink removes the link.

token.description: Access token for the forge, stored in the vault; without it, a github.com repository links through the while App.

unlink.description: true: removes the link and the webhook.

name: link_git_repo
title: Link a git repository
